question: What is the average number of items per delivered order?
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT AVG(item_cnt) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order
FROM (
    SELECT oi.order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
) t
plan: • Count order_items rows per order_id to get items per order; • Join orders to filter where order_status = 'delivered'; • Aggregate by counting items per delivered order and then compute the average across these orders; • Use orders.order_id and order_items.order_id columns; • No additional filters needed; • Return a single numeric value representing the average items per delivered order.
